findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/workflow-convergence-failure-remediation-execution-plan.md:116-122 — Workstream A permits removing the DONE-required phase deadline and relying only on per-command deadlines, but the subordinate done-prepare heartbeat contract requires every heartbeating phase to have an independent hard wall-clock deadline. Per-command timeouts do not bound orchestration hangs before, between, or after child commands. Keep a derived phase deadline (sum of effective sequential command deadlines plus bounded orchestration grace), or explicitly split the phase into mechanically bounded substeps before allowing removal. Severity: medium.

docs/requirements/decisions/workflow-convergence-failure-remediation-execution-plan.md:293-336,417-428 — Workstream D calls the canonical owner-session contract unfinished and lists only role-separation review before implementation. The adopted session-ownership source says B-9089 already implemented the host-neutral contract, while owner-session-contract-execution-plan.md:358-381 mandates fresh independent two-host PASS evidence bound to the document version before any runtime implementation. Reframe D as a regression/adapter-gap correction against shipped behavior and add the mandatory two-host review as an explicit blocking dependency and acceptance artifact; otherwise the execution plan can launch redundant or noncompliant identity work. Severity: medium.
